description: Na₃NiO₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.56 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.60 Å. Ni is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. Both Ni-O bond lengths are 1.79 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ni atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ni atom.
